Legal notice

Fan project

PokéSurvivor is a game made by fans, free and non-profit. It has no ads or purchases.

It is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by Nintendo, Creatures Inc., GAME FREAK or The Pokémon Company. Pokémon and all related names and characters are trademarks and property of their respective owners.

Third-party content

Sprites from SpriteCollab (CC BY-NC 4.0, full credits in the repository's CREDITS.md). Pokédex data from PokeAPI. Pixelify Sans font (OFL). The music and sound effects are original to the project.

License

Code license: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (you may use, study and modify it, but not to make money). Versions up to 14-10-2026 remain under MIT.

Privacy

If you sign in with Google, we store your game (collection, coins, upgrades and stats) on our own server so you can continue on any device. From your Google account we only store your name, email and picture to identify you (they are never shown to other players). We don't use your data for anything else, we don't share it, and there are no ads or tracking. As a guest, nothing is stored outside your browser.

Friends and leaderboard: your nickname is public to other players. We store your friends list, whether you're online and your best times (with your nickname and your Pokémon).

Group games: your browser connects directly to your teammates' browsers (like a video call), so each of you may be able to see the others' IP address. Only play in a group with people you know. To connect, your browsers exchange a few small messages through our server and Google's STUN server.

You can delete your account whenever you want (your nickname, friends and records are deleted too):
